qualitative_visual_check.source: local rasterized northeast and southeast candidate shape previews
qualitative_visual_check.observation: Two northeast mainlands have distinct visual axes, and SE two primary land polygons now stand out from substantially smaller supporting polygons. Less cluttered outer arcs and clearer blue-water gaps. Some smooth blob-shaped coasts persist and would require further geology-grounded visual iteration.

canon_protection: United City and People's Paradise on same central supercontinent
Qintang NW of Sarila and Baitown north of Sarila
Southward huge inner-sea outlet; northern peninsula and resistance arc relationships preserved
Tangxi and R1/R2 remain distinct river systems
25 approved named large seas retained; no arbitrary new coordinate placement
Shattered Sea 32 confirmed island chains unaffected, not tied to draft polygon count
limits: Polygon aesthetic edits do not establish rock hardness, glacier erosion, tidal dynamics, shelf bathymetry, rivers or plate tectonics.
Candidate shapes and numbers remain mutable.
Real online Github Pages and mobile visual rendering not verified.
next_stage: After user visual feedback, B17 can begin regionally consistent relative relief, valley networks and varied coast-type rules on B16 base, avoiding new random blobs. Maintain visual primacy of macro silhouettes.
